items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: You taught him one of those. I showed him the chords.

ctx.x: Did you tell him once that he played strictly on the black keys? Oh, that piano. He had a keys and a chord.

That's right. That's the number, Wining Boy. Now, he'd play that and he'd sing. He was after that number, but he didn't know his keys, his chords. You taught him one of those. I showed him the chords. Now, why he played was all in D flat, five flat, all his music mostly.
Why was that? Did I just hit on it? You know why?
